Job Title: Cloud Support Engineer
Company: Northwind Systems

About the role
We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to keep our customer-facing AWS workloads healthy.

Key Responsibilities
- Troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues on AWS and Linux servers
- Monitor systems with CloudWatch and respond to incidents
- Write Python and Bash scripts to automate routine support tasks
- Document troubleshooting steps and maintain the knowledge base
- Work with REST APIs and SQL databases to investigate data issues

Requirements
- 1+ years of experience in technical support or cloud operations
- Hands-on experience with AWS, Linux and Python
- Strong troubleshooting skills and working knowledge of SQL
- Familiarity with REST APIs
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Nice to have
- Docker or Kubernetes experience is a plus
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner preferred
- Experience with Terraform

Benefits
- Remote-friendly, learning budget
